title: docs(releases): 18.1.0 release facts as measured, and the upgrade checklist walked from 18.0.0
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiRwWtsarkLPmw9fMYiFZ3LY)_

## Summary

18.1.0 is published. This PR does the follow-up work the 18.1 page was waiting on. It is docs-only.

**Release facts, as measured.** This is a new section, measured with `npm view` / `npm pack` on 2026-10-24:
- npm tags: `latest` is 18.1.0 on every package read. `next` still points at the older `18.0.0-next.5`, and `rc` at `17.0.0-rc.6`.
- Publish: npm at 09:06 UTC, followed by 73 per-package GitHub Releases.
- Version commit: `e649c2d91e` (#25606), after the reverted first cut (#25605).

The section also carries two cautions:
- **260 of the 265 CHANGELOG entries cite `3937697`.** That is the commit that reverted the first cut, not each entry's own commit. The published tarballs carry the same attribution: every entry in `@objectstack/cli@18.1.0`'s 18.1.0 section reads `3937697`.
- **An exact pin still floats.** `@objectstack/cli` declares eight `@objectstack/*` dependencies as `workspace:^`, which publishes as a caret range. An app pinned to exactly 18.0.0 therefore installed 17 packages at 18.1.0 today. The checklist gives the pnpm override that holds them, and that override was measured.

**Counts.** These are read off the published sections: 265 distinct entries, split 82 / 9 / 50 / 2 / 122 across the five sections. 91 changesets are declared breaking, 48 `minor` and 43 `patch`. The pre-cut count of 258 was low because entries whose first line is identical were merged; once every first line began with the same revert commit, the eight "Shipped in 18.0.0" entries collapsed into one.

**Upgrade checklist, walked.** I walked one `create-objectstack@18.0.0` blank app on SQLite under `single`. It had an administrator and three notes, and was moved to 18.1.0. Each line the walk measured is marked:
- the pins and the override
- the `os serve` refusal without a secret, and `os start` minting `.objectstack/auth-secret` instead
- the 18.0.0 session still being valid when the same secret is used
- `validate` and `build` passing
- `migrate meta --from 17`, which lists 417 manual changes; `--from 18` replays nothing
- `migrate meta --stored`
- `migrate plan`: 33 nullable tenant columns, schema in sync
- probes of the `confirmText` refusal (422) and the rollback `toVersion` refusal (400)

The callout lists what was not walked.

**Folded in.** #25591, #25592 (breaking) and #25596, the last changesets before the cut.
